title: Egoroff's theorem for Lebesgue measure on ℝⁿ with a closed good set and uniform convergence on compacta
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, let η_k : ℝⁿ → ℝ (k ∈ ℕ) and g : ℝⁿ → ℝ be Borel measurable, let S ⊆ ℝⁿ be a Borel set, and suppose η_k(x) → g(x) as k → ∞ for every x ∈ S. Then for every ε ∈ (0, ∞] there is a closed set A ⊆ S with Lⁿ(S ∖ A) < ε such that η_k → g uniformly on every compact set Q ⊆ A.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (η : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ) (g : Rn n → ℝ) (S : Set (Rn n)), (∀ k, Measurable (η k)) → Measurable g → MeasurableSet S → (∀ x ∈ S, Tendsto (fun k => η k x) atTop (𝓝 (g x))) → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ A ⊆ S, IsClosed A ∧ volume (S \ A) < ε ∧ ∀ Q : Set (Rn n), IsCompact Q → Q ⊆ A → TendstoUniformlyOn η g atTop Q
